contact.name: John Laing
contact.evidence_quote: John Laing, R. Psych. ... At Kaizen, we are proud to partner with the reputable network of psychologists at Hexagon Psychology, including our designated in-house psychologist and resident expert, John Laing, R. Psych. John has decades of experience working with learning differences and mental health issues and oversees our Executive Function Coaching Program.

contacts.rung: Other role. John Laing is the designated in-house psychologist and resident expert who oversees the Executive Function Coaching Program.
